# realization mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:realizationMode`](gmeow-realizationMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/realizationMode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The mode in which an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) realizes its [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) — notated, performed, improvised, orally transmitted, or machine-generated. A frame-carried, value-vocabulary fact at the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) tier; no shape may require a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) to be notated (the oral-tradition guarantee).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) -> [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](../classes/gmeow-RealizationMode.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:realizationMode`](gmeow-realizationMode.md) from [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](../classes/gmeow-RealizationMode.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Score As Lossy Projection

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/music/examples/score-as-lossy-projection.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/music/examples/score-as-lossy-projection.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-music-examples-score-as-lossy-projection)#example-slices-extensions-music-examples-score-as-lossy-projection

```turtle
# --- EXPRESSION (notated): what the page actually encodes, framed by 12-EDO.
ex:notatedExpression a gmeow:Expression ;
    rdfs:label            "engraved notation of the Nocturne"@en ;
    gmeow:realizes        ex:nocturne ;
    gmeow:realizationMode gmeow:realizationModeNotated ;
    gmeow:hasReferenceFrame gmeow:tuningSystem12EDO .

# --- TWO PERFORMANCES: same work, same fixed pitches/durations, divergent where
#     the score is silent — the loss made concrete (neither is privileged, P9).
ex:performanceRubinstein a gmeow:Expression ;
    rdfs:label            "a warm, rubato-rich performance"@en ;
    gmeow:realizes        ex:nocturne ;
    gmeow:realizationMode gmeow:realizationModePerformed ;
    gmeow:hasReferenceFrame gmeow:tuningSystem12EDO ;
    gmeow:wasDerivedFrom  ex:notatedExpression .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md), [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](../classes/gmeow-RealizationMode.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use at the [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) tier to record HOW a musical [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) is realized — notated, performed, improvised, oral, or machine-generated — as a frame-carried value rather than a subclass split.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it on a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) (the [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) is mode-independent) and avoid any shape that requires a notated realization — the oral-tradition guarantee forbids it ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Functional: one mode per [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md).

### How to use

- Point the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) at one [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](../classes/gmeow-RealizationMode.md) individual; a notated and a performed rendition of the same [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) are two Expressions, each with its own mode.

### Examples

- ex:eroicaNotatedExpr [`gmeow:realizationMode`](gmeow-realizationMode.md) [`gmeow:realizationModeNotated`](../individuals/gmeow-realizationModeNotated.md).
